( The Lab Report )

Every decision is auditable.

We don’t rely on “creative intuition.” Every edit, every thumbnail, every hook is tested against retention data. If it doesn’t perform, we kill it and iterate. We publish what we learn — no gatekeeping.

Why this video floppedLab report
Avg. view duration1:24
Retention rate23%
CTR2.1%
The problem
We bored the audience at 0:05. The hook was too slow — 8 seconds of talking head before delivering value.
The fix
Next iteration we cut the intro entirely and opened on a pattern interrupt (visual + audio spike). Retention jumped to 58%.
The lesson
Your audience doesn’t owe you their attention. Earn it in the first frame, or lose them forever.
